using Test, QCLNEGFRunner, QCLNEGF
@assert VERSION == v"1.13.0"
@assert realpath(Base.pkgdir(QCLNEGFRunner)) == realpath(ARGS[1])
@assert realpath(pathof(QCLNEGFRunner)) == realpath(joinpath(ARGS[1],"src","QCLNEGFRunner.jl"))
@assert realpath(Base.pkgdir(QCLNEGF)) == realpath(ARGS[2])
@assert realpath(pathof(QCLNEGF)) == realpath(joinpath(ARGS[2],"src","QCLNEGF.jl"))
println("QCL_IMPORT_IDENTITY\t", Base.pkgdir(QCLNEGFRunner), "\t", pathof(QCLNEGFRunner), "\t", Base.pkgdir(QCLNEGF), "\t", pathof(QCLNEGF))
flush(stdout)
ts = Test.DefaultTestSet("SCI08-R1 bounded selection"; verbose=true)
# Exact pinned Julia 1.13 Test scoped context; no removed push/pop API.
try
    Test.@with_testset ts begin
        for f in ARGS[3:end]
            Base.include(Main, f)
        end
    end
catch err
    err isa InterruptException && rethrow()
    # Match pinned @testset's non-test exception recording before recursive counts.
    Test.record(ts, Test.Error(:nontest_error, Expr(:tuple), err,
        Base.current_exceptions(), LineNumberNode(0, Symbol("SCI08-R1 bootstrap include")), nothing))
end
c = Test.get_test_counts(ts)
function nsets(t)
    1 + sum((nsets(x) for x in t.results if x isa Test.DefaultTestSet); init=0)
end
println("QCL_COUNTS\t", c.passes+c.cumulative_passes, "\t", c.fails+c.cumulative_fails, "\t", c.errors+c.cumulative_errors, "\t", c.broken+c.cumulative_broken, "\t", nsets(ts)-1)
flush(stdout)
Test.finish(ts)
println("QCL_SELECTION_FINISHED")
flush(stdout)
